Benchmarks 1-6 and 8-10 only assert finite state (they did before too). Add independent reference values.
Outside the band it outputs u unchanged. Simulink Dead Zone gives y = u - upper (u > upper) and y = u - lower (u < lower), so the output is continuous.

The lab used the dead param Rth=35, so the heater ran on the default R (about 5.3 kW). Now R=35, about 1.5 kW (realistic). Behaviour change in the shipped lab.
Per-eval catch returns zeros(equationCount) on exceptions, and compRes[i] || 0 turns NaN into 0. Silent-zero/NaN masking violates the mandate.
A scalar solver port carries one channel. clarke, inv_clarke, inv_sym_comp, im/pmsm_curr_ctrl and ps_sine_3phase carry channel 1 only. Needs vector signal ports.

findings.summary: Frame mapping assigns coords by branch NAME (force->X, torque->Rx). revolute torque->Rx and prismatic force->Px regardless of axis. weld has a single force->Px. Frame pose unknowns are exempt from the structural check.
Still strips /_[st]$/ from probe handles.
labs_sim / vlab_comprehensive / airfryer time out at 5 s under full parallel load. Set per-file timeouts or speed them up. Now also whitebox M-01 and pid_ac_motor; it repeatedly pollutes the gates.
Non-convergence at minimumStep still silently accepts the stale xCurrent, so the result is wrong but looks valid.
Singular pivots are regularized to 1e-12, and diag<1e-15 gives 0 silently.
prevY is found by ctx.states.indexOf(value), a value lookup, so the index is wrong when values coincide.
Outputs are in degrees, not SI rad.
Number(val)||0 masks a NaN param in the separate kernel pipeline.

There are no rigid-body inertia dynamics: pendulum period, energy and sliding acceleration cannot be simulated. Joint tests are quasi-static only. Rigid body mass/inertia (Newton-Euler) is needed for real multibody dynamics.
Adds Euler angles componentwise and passes no lever-arm moment.
Reports an Euler difference, not the relative rotation.
Joint rates assume a backward difference, but the SDIRK stage dt differs from the step.
Kt and Ke are separate params. Kt != Ke creates or destroys energy (documented). Consider tying them in SI or warning.
No hydraulic pump/motor/cylinder with a shaft or rod port exists (pump_il is an ideal pressure source).
No slack (tension-only) condition and no damping term c(dx_e - dx_r) as spec 2.4 requires.
Old t/f ports removed. Saved models get an unknown-port diagnostic. Consider a migration that drops those edges with a notice.

WP-09c used the phasor magnitude via dx/dt (ripple, first step wrong). Planner did NOT sign off: implement the Simscape Sequence Analyzer method (running one-fundamental-period Fourier at f0), output magnitude and phase per the library.

Unconnected electrical ports named b/c/n/ref/gnd are pinned to ground by NAME (only phase_splitter is exempt). Replace with explicit reference semantics. Check three_phase_source, machines and inverters.

findings.summary: Inputs m and ang are unread.
node_modules lost the same 92 packages twice (incl. @babel/runtime, @alloc/quick-lru, the .bin shims), the second time during a full src/utils test run at 00:34. Find which test/script prunes it.
Backward Euler is used even with BDF2 on (only isDifferentialState vars get the BDF2 stencil, vlabPhysics ~l.376), so RC/RLC are first order (err ~ h/(2tau)). Hurts every Simscape comparison.
Hard-coded +pi/4 phase shift, absolute potentials to ground with no return; listed in IMPLICIT_ABSOLUTE_POTENTIAL_BLOCKS. Decide on a composite port.
Default phase pi/4 (Simscape 0) is locked by ac_voltage_parameters.test.ts. Sources also have a non-ideal R_int (dev).
Does not honour capacitor v0 / inductor i0.
Memristor uses a simplified unvalidated drift model; the opamp clamp is C0 (consider smooth).

Frame-pose variables are pinned to BDF1 (system.firstOrderOnly). Joint rates w = dangle/dt assume a backward difference, so mechanisms stay first order. BDF2 there gave spurious velocities on held DOFs.
Hard-coded (x - x_prev)/0.01 derivative ignores the step.
Default b=0.1 adds viscous damping that F = m dv/dt does not state (Simscape Mass has none).
The c*w term is discontinuous at the stop threshold. Fragile for Newton; passes only via the SDIRK fallback. Use the Simscape hard-stop formulation (smooth or event-based).

With real 50 Hz induction dynamics the labs take 16-22 s each (dense numeric Jacobian ~50 us/residual, h ~0.1 ms by LTE). test:vlab went from 15 s to 64 s; per-test 240 s timeouts were added to 8 lab tests. Needs a sparse/analytic Jacobian, Jacobian reuse, and checks on UI interactivity.

The labs ground the motor star point while the inverter output has a 0.5 Vdc common mode, giving a non-physical kA DC zero-sequence current (pre-existing, now visible). Float the star point or reference the inverter midpoint.
DEVIATION: machine shafts have only R with a library-declared internal mechanical reference (no Simscape-style C case port). Adding C needs an instance-port migration.
migrationNotices (Kt != Ke) are stored in node.data but not shown in the UI.
A located switching edge is accepted up to minimumStep (1 us) late, so at 20 kHz the duty drifts ~2 % (buck Vo +1.4 %). Needs proper event-time interpolation; minimumStep 1e-9 stalls.
The algebraic Newton does not converge at some steps for the 12-switch bridge; bridge tests take 10-30 s each.
theta semantics differ (absolute deg vs rad offset + ramp).

findings.summary: The solver loops forever (synchronous, no timeout) despite the WP-04 rejected-step budget: accepted tiny steps or an inner loop are not bounded. In the app this freezes the worker. Needs a total step/wall-clock guard.
Remain explicitly unsupported: no stated meaning/units for the separator w/d outputs, and the selector composite layout is undefined.
Moist air carries only p and mdot; T and phi are block params, so ma_pt_sensor.t reports its param, not a measured value (deviation).
The structural probe uses non-physical points (p ~ 1 Pa); the dependence threshold lowered to 1e-13 to see stiff gas rows. Consider physically scaled probe points.
The other session is adding data-help-feature attributes to V-Lab UI files (uncommitted, not ours). WP-40 must coordinate to avoid conflicts.
WP-17 regression: vlab_full_certification boundary case 2 returns a non-finite residual.
Threshold events end a cut step just after the jump, so backward Euler integrates the post-jump value over that sub-step (~1e-4 error). Land just before the root.
Missing Simulink/Simscape signal blocks: derivative, relay, quantizer, rate limiter, compare, counter, ZOH, clock, chirp, pulse, mux, scalar-to-vector; ps_sum has a scalar port only.
